messages.content: The Loop, West Loop, and River North are fantastic upscale and highly walkable neighborhoods perfect for solo travelers seeking safety and friendly service. These areas are well-policed, packed with 24-hour amenities, and full of people who are accustomed to visitors exploring on their own in the city. I highly recommend arriving at least a week early to familiarize yourself with the transit and minimize any travel nerves before you venture out.
